instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: The Putnam resource allocation model is based on...
questions.question_ar: نموذج بوتنام لتخصيص الموارد قائم على...
questions.explanation: Putnam models the manpower profile with the Norden/Rayleigh curve.
questions.explanation_ar: بوتنام ينمذج منحنى القوى العاملة بمنحنى نوردن/رايلي.

questions.question: How does Putnam express the difficulty metric?
questions.question_ar: كيف يعبّر بوتنام عن مقياس الصعوبة؟
options: K times the cube of time too
K divided by the cube of time
K divided by the square of time
K divided by time here now
options_en: K times the cube of time too
K divided by the cube of time
K divided by the square of time
K divided by time here now
questions.explanation: Difficulty D equals K over the cube of development time, so time reduces difficulty fast.
questions.explanation_ar: الصعوبة D تساوي K على مكعب زمن التطوير، فالزمن يخفّض الصعوبة سريعاً.

questions.question: What shape does the Rayleigh manpower curve take?
questions.question_ar: ما شكل منحنى رايلي للقوى العاملة؟
options: it falls then rises at the end
it rises to a peak then decays
it stays flat through the project
options_en: it falls then rises at the end
it rises to a peak then decays
it stays flat through the project
questions.explanation: Manpower grows to a single peak and then decays, which is the Rayleigh shape.
questions.explanation_ar: القوى العاملة تنمو إلى ذروة واحدة ثم تتلاشى، وهذا شكل رايلي.

questions.question: How is the peak manpower rate expressed in Putnam's model?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن ذروة معدل القوى العاملة في نموذج بوتنام؟
options: K over the square of the time now here
two K over the time here too here
K times the root of e now again
K over the time times the root of e
options_ar: ضعف K على الزمن هنا مجدداً
K مضروبة بجذر e الآن هنا
K على الزمن مضروباً بجذر e
options_en: K over the square of the time now here
two K over the time here too here
K times the root of e now again
K over the time times the root of e
questions.explanation: The peak rate is K divided by the product of development time and the square root of e.
questions.explanation_ar: الذروة هي K مقسومة على حاصل ضرب زمن التطوير في جذر e.

questions.question: About what share of total effort falls in the development sub-cycle?
questions.question_ar: كم تقريباً من الجهد الكلي يقع في دورة التطوير الفرعية؟
questions.explanation: Roughly forty per cent of the effort sits in the development sub-cycle; the rest is elsewhere.
questions.explanation_ar: نحو أربعين بالمئة من الجهد في دورة التطوير الفرعية، والباقي في مواضع أخرى.

questions.question: How is Risk Exposure computed?
questions.explanation: Risk Exposure multiplies the probability of the event by the size of the loss.
questions.explanation_ar: التعرّض للخطر يضرب احتمال الحدث في حجم الخسارة.

questions.question: Risk management activities are divided into...
questions.explanation: Risk management splits into risk assessment and risk control, so two categories.
questions.explanation_ar: إدارة المخاطر تنقسم إلى تقييم المخاطر وضبط المخاطر، أي فئتان.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a risk management activity?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس نشاطاً من أنشطة إدارة المخاطر؟
questions.explanation: Assessment and control are the two activities; nobody generates risk on purpose.
questions.explanation_ar: التقييم والضبط هما النشاطان، ولا أحد يولّد المخاطر عمداً.

questions.question: Cost estimation for a project may include...
questions.explanation: A full project estimate covers software, hardware and personnel together.
questions.explanation_ar: التقدير الكامل للمشروع يغطي البرمجيات والعتاد والأفراد معاً.

questions.question: Which one is NOT infrastructure software?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس برمجيات بنية تحتية؟
questions.explanation: Infrastructure means operating systems, DBMS and compilers, not an application result system.
questions.explanation_ar: البنية التحتية تعني أنظمة التشغيل وقواعد البيانات والمترجمات، لا نظام نتائج تطبيقي.

questions.question: In Putnam's software equation, what does the size S depend on?
questions.question_ar: في معادلة بوتنام، على ماذا يعتمد الحجم S؟
options: the function point count now here
the number of modules here again too
the number of cost drivers too now
options_en: the function point count now here
the number of modules here again too
the number of cost drivers too now
questions.explanation: S is set by effort raised to one third and time raised to four thirds, scaled by technology.
questions.explanation_ar: S يتحدد بالجهد أس ثلث والزمن أس أربعة أثلاث، مضروباً بعامل التقنية.
